---
title: "Contratos y cobros"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Contratos y cuentas por cobrar</h1><div class="tf-muted">Los cobros se generan al cerrar cada mes. El inicio y fin parciales se prorratean por días calendario.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem">
<button id="contract-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo contrato</button>
<button id="tariff-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Nueva tarifa</button>
<button id="contract-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Finalizados / archivados</button>
</div>
<div class="tf-grid tf-grid-2"><section id="contract-editor" class="tf-card" hidden><h2>Nuevo contrato</h2><form id="contract-form" class="tf-form-grid">
<div class="tf-field"><label>Cliente / proyecto</label><input id="contract-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio trabajo</label><input id="contract-start" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fin previsto (opcional)</label><input id="contract-end" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Desfase de pago (meses)</label><input id="contract-lag" type="number" min="0" value="6"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Día esperado de pago</label><input id="contract-pay-day" type="number" min="1" max="31" value="1"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tarifa inicial mensual ($)</label><input id="contract-rate" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Transporte mensual estimado ($)</label><input id="contract-transport" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Otros costos directos mensuales ($)</label><input id="contract-other-cost" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
<div class="tf-span-2"><label>Asignación a activos</label><div id="contract-allocations"></div><div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.5rem"><button id="add-contract-allocation" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Añadir activo</button><span id="allocation-total" class="tf-muted"></span></div></div>
<div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar contrato</button><button id="contract-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></section>
<section id="tariff-editor" class="tf-card" hidden><h2>Nueva tarifa</h2><form id="tariff-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Contrato</label><select id="tariff-contract"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Vigente desde</label><input id="tariff-from" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tarifa mensual ($)</label><input id="tariff-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Agregar período tarifario</button><button id="tariff-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></section></div>
<div id="contract-list" class="tf-grid tf-grid-3" style="margin-top:1rem"></div>
<div id="receivables-section" class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem"><h2>Cuentas por cobrar</h2><div class="tf-toolbar"><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta destino</label><select id="payment-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto recibido ($)</label><input id="payment-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div><button id="allocate-payment" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Aplicar a seleccionados</button></div><div class="tf-table-wrap" style="margin-top:.7rem"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th></th><th>Contrato</th><th>Período</th><th>Generado</th><th>Pagado</th><th>Pendiente</th><th>Vence</th><th>Estado</th></tr></thead><tbody id="recv-body"></tbody></table></div></div>

<dialog id="contract-finish-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><form method="dialog" id="contract-finish-form"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Cierre contractual</div><h2>Finalizar / programar fin</h2></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" value="cancel">Cerrar</button></div><div class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha efectiva de finalización</label><input id="contract-finish-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-span-2" id="contract-finish-preview"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions" style="justify-content:flex-end"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" value="cancel">Cancelar</button><button id="contract-finish-confirm" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar fecha</button></div></div></form></dialog>
<script type="module" src="js/contracts.js"></script>
```
